六级大纲词汇 · 08英文原文

The Latch in the Video

录像里的门闩 · 593 词 · 7 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1A shopkeeper hired Mina, a young solicitor, after a fire in a rented warehouse. The owner filed a lawsuit claiming the tenant had caused the fire through negligence. The tenant might forfeit his deposit. The lease stipulated that the key be returned by seven. A guard's log recorded the transfer of custody. The plaintiff supplied a photograph that seemed to show the tenant's van outside at eight. The assertion merited scrutiny.

2The owner disclosed only a printout. Mina applied for mandatory disclosure of the original surveillance file. A magistrate granted the request. The video looked credible until she saw the gate swing open. The guard testified that he had detained a man there that afternoon. The latch broke during the attempt to force entry, and he fitted a chain. If his testimony was accurate, the clip must predate the fire. The owner called it a dubious evasion and said the guard wanted to evade responsibility. Mina summoned the worker who had fitted the chain.

3Under oath the worker produced a receipt from that afternoon. The technician who exported the clip gave a second account. During questioning he disclosed a reset that could assign a new date to footage already in memory. A note about it had disappeared from the owner's submission. Mina could refute the date without proving fraud. There was still no evidence the photograph itself was fraudulent. The court could investigate whether a malicious act had obstructed disclosure later.

4The owner asserted that the technician and guard had conspired to protect the tenant. Mina asked for evidence of a conspiracy. An absurdity became clear. The guard could not alter a file he had never opened. He mentioned a ride the tenant gave the guard. That did not establish blackmail, intimidation, or retaliation. The judge refused to presume collusion. A fire investigator described the cause. The investigator had found a short circuit behind a door the tenant had no right to unlock. A written warning about the wiring had gone unanswered.

5The court ruled the photograph invalid as proof of a second visit. The judge called the owner negligent for his reckless disregard of that warning. The verdict upheld the tenant's right to recover the deposit. Whether the missing note was deliberate remained a question for an authority with jurisdiction to probe obstruction. Anyone who wanted to prosecute the omission would need evidence of a deliberate act. A civil finding could not overturn the presumption of innocence in a criminal case. The owner still had a pending claim for one week's rent.

6Mina proposed that they arbitrate the rent separately. Arbitration would concern only that debt. She drew a narrow waiver so the tenant could settle it without surrendering the judgment. The waiver would not infringe his right to collect the deposit. He would waive only the late fees. Mina warned that a broader stipulation could breach their agreement and make the result harder to enforce. They reached a settlement after the owner produced a second receipt. The tenant asked whether he should sue over the owner's conduct. Mina laid out his choices without urging him to retaliate.

7On his way out he asked what had made her doubt the photograph. Mina showed him two pictures of the gate. In one, the latch held. In the other, a chain did. The key mattered because the lease named a time. The latch mattered because it offered a way to test that time. He could now explain why the case had turned on an ordinary repair rather than on anyone's guess about a photograph.

六级大纲词汇 · 08中文译文

录像里的门闩

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1租来的仓库起火后，店主聘请了年轻律师米娜。房东起诉租户，称他的疏忽导致了火灾。租户可能因此拿不回押金。租约规定晚上七点前归还钥匙，门卫的登记簿记下了交接时间。作为原告，房东拿出一张照片，看上去租户的货车八点还在仓库外。这一说法值得仔细核查。

2房东只提供了一张打印件。米娜申请强制调取原始监控文件，治安法官同意了。录像原本很可信，直到米娜看见大门摆开。门卫说，他当天下午在那儿扣住过一个人。有人强行闯入时弄断了门闩，他便在门上加了一条链子。如果证词准确，录像就拍在火灾之前。房东怀疑这是托词，说门卫想逃避责任。米娜请装链条的工人出庭。

3工人宣誓后拿出一张当天下午的收据。导出录像的技术人员又提供了另一条线索。他在询问中透露，设备重置后，存储器里的旧录像可能被赋予新日期。说明这件事的一张便条没有出现在房东的材料里。米娜只需推翻录像显示的日期。现有证据还无法证明照片本身造假。至于是否有人故意阻碍披露，可以另外调查。

4房东声称技术人员和门卫串通起来保护租户。米娜请他拿出串通的证据。问题很快显出来，门卫从未打开那个文件，怎么可能修改它？房东提到租户曾让门卫搭过一次车。这证明不了勒索、恐吓或报复。法官没有预先认定他们串通，而是听取了火灾调查人员对起火原因的说明。短路发生在一扇门后，租户无权打开那扇门。此前还有一份关于线路的书面警告，却一直没得到处理。

5法院裁定，那张照片不能证明租户又来过。法官认定房东无视警告，有疏忽。判决确认租户有权拿回押金。便条是否被故意漏掉，由有权限的机关调查。如果要就此提起公诉，需要有证据证明当事人故意为之。民事裁定不能推翻刑事案件中的无罪推定。与此同时，房东还有一项一周租金的请求尚未处理。

6米娜提议把租金单独交给仲裁。仲裁范围只涉及那笔欠款。她拟了一份范围很窄的权利放弃条款，避免租户在解决租金时一并放弃已经取得的判决权利。他仍可收回押金，只放弃追讨滞纳金。米娜提醒，条款太宽可能损害现有协议，影响执行。房东拿出第二张收据后，双方达成了和解。租户问要不要再起诉房东，米娜把几种选择说清楚，把决定留给他自己。

7出门时，租户问米娜为什么会怀疑那张照片。她给他看了大门的两张照片。一张上门闩完好，另一张上靠链条把门拴住。钥匙重要，因为租约规定了时间。门闩重要，因为它能检验录像所显示的时间。现在他自己也能说清，这个案子为什么会因为一次普通的修理而有了转机。
